title: TopologySemanticSelector
description: Typed, catalog-backed selector for compiling a topology artifact overlay. Natural language is resolved before this request; topology-service validates and executes catalog ids against the active topology graph.

actionCatalogId.description: Semantic catalog action id corresponding to the overlay action being compiled.

semanticEntity.description: Semantic entity being selected, for example inventory.device or inventory.interface.

surfaceEntity.description: Topology surface entity that represents the semantic entity, for example topology.node or topology.edge.

targetKind.description: Topology overlay target kind produced by this selector.

predicates.description: Catalog-backed predicates combined with AND semantics. Multiple backend paths for one catalog id are evaluated as OR by topology-service.
